svg.title: Known-best packing of 132 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=132 construction, never the source witness: its exact frame with the free grid slack closed and the near-axis squares straightened at the record's side, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's. Regularized by the Squares Project with Evan Daniel's regularizer (evand/square-packing, MIT).

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 2026-11-11 rational centre-basis witness at 132, read exactly from the retained source file without its schema envelope, in the watched repository JoostdeWinter/square-packing, which jlevy/squares#958 names: a pinwheel the source derives from Samanyu-dev's public 109-square packing, by one cut-and-fill step. Finite construction feasibility only; the 250-digit contact solution, local optimum, KKT, rigidity, same-packing, novelty, priority and global optimality are not replayed here.

svg.text: U n=132 regularized: side ~ 11.97604838 (certified upper bound)
